targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1070a (diagnostic, FAIL, substrate_not_ready_requeue): non_contributory for ARC-029, without qualification -- the run's own routes_to is correct and this autopsy rescues nothing from it. Successor to V3-EXQ-1070, which failed the SAME readiness precondition. The two-stage per-(rung,seed) pilot cut the realised training-tick spread from 3.9588 to 2.2786 and carried all 30 cells to completion where 1070 decided at block 5 of 10, but the 2.0 ceiling is still exceeded by 13.93% (2331/1023, max at L5_extreme seed 42, min at L0_lineage_control seed 42). All four scored criteria D1-D4 passed and 5 of 6 preconditions are green; the single red one carries the outcome, since outcome = all(preconditions) AND ladder_non_degenerate. WHY NOTHING IS CITEABLE FROM IT. P1 is feasible in 30/30 cells but carries no information: the detrended quantile bar is contract-pinned to fire at ~q, the window it is estimated over spans 15-39 EPISODES in every cell (38.8 at L0), which GFLAG-0371 pre-rejected in terms -- 'Filling the window would pool rv across ~35 episode boundaries, so it would not be the within-run distribution the estimator is specified against' -- and this run is the STATIC arm (breath_period=0, MECH-108 OFF, asserted at driver :679) while ARC-029's P1 is specified for the ALTERNATING arm. harm_snr >= 10 is therefore the sole binding discriminator, and the feasible-rung identity (3 of 5; 22 of 30 cells) is confounded by unequal training and must not be cited. An earlier draft of this autopsy offered a narrow residual at L0/L1 and WITHDREW it: P3 at the lineage env was never in dispute (GFLAG-0371 already records reward/step 20-100x above the band P3 worries about), so the residual was the predecessor autopsy's withdrawn P1 rescue in new clothes. ON THE GATE ITSELF: it is sound and its per-cell denominator is deliberate. The driver at :60-67 considered gating on per-rung means and rejected it because 1070's per-rung means were 2.83, still over the ceiling, and because 'It also relaxes the precondition, which the repair brief forbids'. Only the precondition's one-line description ('across rungs') is compressed against what it computes. Within-rung, realised ticks still vary up to 1.89x, and episode length -- the manipulated variable -- predicts low harm_snr across all 5 rungs while tick count predicts it across 4, so the residual confound is better read as episode length than as training depth; at n=3 informative rungs the 'higher-tick seed is worse' pattern is p = 0.125 and is not leaned on. ON V3-EXQ-1066: it is NOT awaiting a re-queue. It RAN and ERRORed 2026-09-20T15:08:23Z (ree-cloud-3), its diagnosis is owned by an active claim, and chip chip-20260921-diagnose-exq-1066 is claimed by a live session. Its Step-4 refusal (GFLAG-0371) is a multi-clause bind of which this run falsifies only the bar_in_force clause -- already recorded in the prereg addendum before 1070a ran -- and the driver could not run at L0/L1 as written in any case (WARM_EPISODE_CAP=30 against 39 episodes needed at L0; env hard-coded to the lineage kwargs; its P3 counts harm EVENTS, not SNR). failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1070a_2026-09-22.

learning_extracted: A successor that repairs a gate can still fail it, and the second failure is the more informative one: the closed-loop per-(rung,seed) pilot cut the tick spread 3.9588 -> 2.2786 and still missed, because episode length under a still-learning policy is not stationary between the pilot and the run it budgets (mispredicted 0.5629x-2.1499x).

Before offering a residual from a red-gated run, check what the ORIGINAL refusal already granted. GFLAG-0371 had already measured P3 at the lineage env as 20-100x clear, so the L0/L1 residual this autopsy drafted was new only in the half (P1) that the same flag pre-rejected as a cross-episode pooling artefact.

Check which ARM the claim's precondition is specified for. ARC-029's P1 names the ALTERNATING arm; 1070a asserts breath_period == 0. A precondition measured on the wrong arm is not a weaker measurement of it, it is not a measurement of it.

A statistic that looks mismatched to its own description may be deliberate. The per-cell tick spread reads like a slip against a description saying 'across rungs', but the driver had already considered and forbidden the per-rung-mean version as a relaxation -- the description is compressed, the statistic is not wrong.

'Never scored a run' is not 'never ran'. Step 7b's C1 named v3_exq_1066 as an unused driver on disk; it had run and ERRORed 40 minutes before this run started, with a live chip and an active claim already on its diagnosis.

Separate the statistic a precondition GATES on from the window a statistic is ESTIMATED over -- the driver carries mean_committed_run_length and its _flat twin side by side (:874-881) precisely so those cannot be confused.
